title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/items/*.yaml
description: Canonical item records, split by category (`weapons-close-combat`, `armour`, `miscellaneous`, `trollheim`, …). Every file of `catalog/items/` carries the same shape: the envelope and its item records. Item ids are stable and reference the executable layer through `mechanic_id`.

kind.description: Item category; it matches the file the record lives in (`trollheim-equipment` for the Trollheim catalogue, `out-of-scope` for records kept only for reference).

tags.description: Cross-cutting families the printed rules reason about as a set (`blackpowder` weapons, `bow`/`crossbow` missile types, `poison` items, `animal` companions). The vocabulary is closed: a band prohibition token resolves through these tags instead of keeping its own list of item ids.

effect.description: Editorial text of the item as printed in its source.

combat_status.description: `implemented` items drive the duel runtime through their mechanic; `out_of_scope` items are carried for the campaign runtime and the UI only.

mechanic_id.description: Mechanic of `catalog/mechanics/close-combat.yaml` that implements the item. It is the object's default profile: the one a bearer uses unless another declared grip is selected.

alternate_mechanic_ids.description: Further mechanics of `catalog/mechanics/close-combat.yaml` the *same physical object* is used with, printed as other modes of one entry (the two grips of the Yari). They are offered and accepted beside `mechanic_id` for a bearer of this item, with the item's own line, cost and recipient — never as a second item record and never as another copy of the equipment. `mechanic_id` stays the default profile, and this member is readable only for an `implemented` object: an out-of-scope record has no executable profile to offer.

allOf.description: An implemented item must name the mechanic that implements it (`load_simulation_mappings` fails without it).
Only an implemented object offers executable profiles, so an out-of-scope record cannot declare a grip.
